author: Claude Opus subagent for Fable (curation, wording and line choices); copied unchanged into the app on 2026-11-09
license: Original project content. Positions are standard textbook ideas re-set by the curator; no book text or diagram was copied.
verification: Every position has 7 or fewer pieces. Root result, every solver move and every opponent reply were checked against the Lichess Syzygy tablebase; each line was replayed with chess.js 1.4.0; a shadow check mirrored the app's puzzle schema.
ratings: Difficulty values (700-1500) are the curator's estimates on the app's 600-1800 scale, not measured from solve data.
grading: Exact match with the stored line, except that any mating final move is accepted. The README lists the plies where other moves also keep the result; the app's feedback says 'not the move this drill is practising' rather than calling them mistakes.
opponent: Opponent replies are scripted, tablebase-justified moves. There is no resisting engine ('engine defends' mode is an open owner decision, default off).
